description: A new plan's header `> **Memory relied on**:` line is extracted into new_plans[].memory_relied_on as the ` | `-separated headings, each stripped (whitespace around a heading dropped, its inner spacing and case kept); a `;`, a `,` or a `|` touching a non-space character never splits a heading; memory_relied_on_truncated is false when nothing was cut.
